nav.title: Auth
nav.description: Login, signup, reset and a social row as one class — view switching is the behavior that earns it.

nav.title: Click a row: it opens on the right
nav.description: One list-and-detail view: a resizable list on the left, the row you clicked on the right.

nav.title: Card
nav.description: The look of an AI card's own page — its head, its outline, a Live-card row — the same CSS whether the card opens in the AI rail or on its own page.

nav.title: Content
nav.description: The kinds of card a page is built from — ask a question, make a decision, quote a prompt.

nav.title: The template tier
nav.description: Chapters of lessons: a rail, a reading column and a next-up card that coordinate — the large-screen showcase.

nav.title: Dictate
nav.description: A mic button with a state you can always see and an error said in plain words — whisper running on this machine first, the browser's own recognition second.

nav.title: Filter
nav.description: A segment + search class that drives several regions at once — the coordinated-regions dashboard.

nav.title: Hotkeys
nav.description: One flat list of named hotkeys, filterable and rebindable — a key or a mouse button, remembered per browser.

nav.title: Pinned: an agent left you a risk
nav.description: A rail of page previews beside the page you picked: persistent navigation that never jumps, with filters, a score floor, read/unread and archive.

nav.title: Menu
nav.description: ui/menu's <details> opened up — close-on-pick and click-outside as a class, instead of a handler you write per item.

nav.title: Objects
nav.description: The live object inspector widget. Walks class instances, Maps, Arrays, and links classes.

nav.title: Pagination
nav.description: ui/pagination's row, opened up — the current page remembered on the instance, and go(n) driving real content through one wire.

nav.title: Popover
nav.description: The owner's two popup options, built and compared: near-content position: absolute, against the popover attribute's top layer.

nav.title: Rename
nav.description: Tap a title to select it, then Rename turns it into a dropdown of 5 suggested names plus keep current.

nav.title: Revise
nav.description: Text in, revised text out, at a level — the AI step of dictation, usable for a prompt or for writing.

nav.title: Tags
nav.description: ui/tags's chip row, opened up — the × and the field were inert in the template; this is what wiring them looks like.

nav.title: Tree
nav.description: One tree — expandable, draggable, and it folds itself around what you select.

nav.title: Understand
nav.description: A ✓ or ? after every sentence the assistant read — green means clear, yellow opens a clarifying question right there in the flow.

nav.title: Name
nav.description: The generic multi-step engine - steps, next/back, a validation gate, keyboard, phone to 3440. Lessons, courses and signup all extend this.
